dashboard_notifications_badge.title: Check Alerts
dashboard_notifications_badge.description: Open the bell to review reminders, pain alerts, and plan updates.
dashboard_notifications_badge.long_text: Notifications cover assessment prompts, plan changes, and adherence nudges.

dashboard_progress_cta.title: Resume Session
dashboard_progress_cta.description: Tap to jump back into your guided exercise recording or start today’s routine.
dashboard_progress_cta.long_text: This button launches the recording flow with your next prescribed exercise.

assessment_preliminary_start.title: Begin Assessment
assessment_preliminary_start.description: Start your clinical assessment to tailor plans to your goals and symptoms.
assessment_preliminary_start.long_text: We will guide you through goals, pain checks, history, and camera assessments.

record_camera_toggle.title: Switch Camera
record_camera_toggle.description: Swap between front and rear cameras without leaving the recording session.

record_pause_button.title: Pause & Rest
record_pause_button.description: Pause recording to log partial progress and review instructions.

record_finish_button.title: Finish & Save
record_finish_button.description: Complete the set to review cooldown guidance and save metrics.

reports_export_pdf.title: Export Reports
reports_export_pdf.description: Generate a PDF summary with pain charts and adherence stats for your clinician.

welcome_sign_in.title: Sign In Securely
welcome_sign_in.description: Authenticate with your email to sync rehab plans and progress.

welcome_guest_mode.title: Preview as Guest
welcome_guest_mode.description: Explore core flows without creating an account. Data stays on-device.

welcome_register_link.title: Create Account
welcome_register_link.description: Need full tracking? Open registration to set up your secure profile.

profile_logout_action.title: Sign Out Safely
profile_logout_action.description: Use Logout to end your session and protect medical data.
profile_logout_action.long_text: We automatically sync progress before signing out so you can resume later.
